definition: scikit-mutliflow (also known as skmultiflow) is a free and open source software machine learning library for multi-output/multi-label and stream data written in Python.
details: scikit-mutliflow (also known as skmultiflow) is a free and open source software machine learning library for multi-output/multi-label and stream data written in Python.

explainer.lead: scikit-multiflow is a free, open-source Python machine learning library for multi-output/multi-label and stream data. It matters for learning settings where data arrives continuously and labels are multiple.

tiers.eli5: It's a Python toolkit for learning from data that keeps flowing in, where each example can have several labels at once.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it to train and evaluate models incrementally as streams arrive; a pitfall is that stream evaluation needs prequential methods, so ordinary batch cross-validation gives misleading results.
tiers.paperLevel: Formally it targets multi-output/multi-label and streaming learning, updating models incrementally rather than on a fixed dataset. Limits: it is a specialized library, so algorithm coverage and ecosystem support are narrower than general ML frameworks.

explainer.example: A model updates with each incoming stream sample and predicts multiple tags per document.
